name: BuySellonYourPrice
summary: A semi-automated order placement EA that allows traders to manually specify entry price, stop loss, and take profit, then places a single order of the selected type (market, limit, or stop) when no existing orders or positions are present. It acts as a convenience tool for executing pre-configured trades rather than implementing an autonomous trading strategy.
summary_zh: 一个半自动下单工具EA，允许交易者手动设定入场价、止损和止盈，然后在无持仓和挂单时按照所选订单类型（市价、限价或止损单）执行一次下单。它本质上是下单辅助工具，而非自主策略EA。
strategy_analysis: 该EA不包含自主交易策略，而是依赖用户手动输入参数来决定交易方向和入场价位。入场条件完全由用户通过SelectMode枚举选择订单类型（市价买入/卖出、限价买入/卖出、止损买入/卖出），市价单以当前Ask/Bid成交，限价和止损单以用户指定价格挂单。出场条件由用户手动设定的Sl和Tp参数决定止损和止盈价位，没有任何动态追踪或条件触发出场逻辑。仓位管理方面仅使用固定的qty参数作为手数，不支持根据账户余额或风险比例动态调整仓位。资金管理完全缺失，没有最大持仓限制、没有回撤控制、没有资金分配逻辑，用户需要自行承担所有资金管理责任。该EA在OnTick中持续检查订单和持仓数量，仅在OrdersTotal和PositionsTotal均为0时才下单，防止重复下单但无法处理部分平仓后的重新入场。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA does not contain an autonomous trading strategy; it relies entirely on user-specified parameters to determine trade direction and entry price. Entry conditions are dictated by the user selecting an order type via the SelectMode enumeration (Market Buy/Sell, Buy/Sell Limit, Buy/Sell Stop), with market orders executing at the current Ask/Bid and pending orders placed at the user-specified entry price. Exit conditions consist solely of the static Sl and Tp values set by the user, with no trailing stop, conditional exit, or dynamic exit logic whatsoever. Position sizing uses only the fixed qty input parameter with no dynamic lot calculation based on account equity, risk percentage, or volatility. Money management is entirely absent—there is no maximum drawdown control, no equity protection, no position scaling, and the user bears full responsibility for risk management. The EA checks OrdersTotal and PositionsTotal on every tick to prevent duplicate orders, but it cannot handle re-entry after partial closes and lacks any state management beyond this simple guard.

parameters.name: entryprice
parameters.description: 限价/止损订单的入场价格（市价单无效）
parameters.description_en: 限价/止损订单的入场价格（市价单无效）

parameters.name: SelectMode
parameters.description: 订单类型选择：无/市价买/市价卖/限价买/限价卖/止损买/止损卖
parameters.description_en: 订单类型选择：无/市价买/市价卖/限价买/限价卖/止损买/止损卖

pros: 操作简单直观，用户只需设定参数即可快速下单，适合手动交易者使用
支持6种订单类型，覆盖了常见的市价单、限价单和止损单，功能较为全面
通过OrdersTotal和PositionsTotal双重检查防止重复下单，有基本的安全防护
下单时传递了注释信息，便于在策略测试器和历史记录中追踪订单来源
pros_en: Simple and intuitive operation—users only need to set parameters to quickly place orders, suitable for manual traders
Supports 6 order types covering common market, limit, and stop orders, providing comprehensive order placement functionality
Dual check via OrdersTotal and PositionsTotal prevents duplicate order placement, providing a basic safety guard
Order comments are passed to the trade functions, facilitating order tracking in the Strategy Tester and account history
cons: 没有任何自主策略逻辑，完全依赖手动输入，不属于自动化交易系统
止损和止盈使用绝对价格而非点数，对不同品种和价格区间需要手动换算，容易出错
每tick都执行检查和打印警告，SelectMode为None时会产生大量无用日志输出
缺乏错误处理，交易函数返回值未被检查，下单失败时用户无法得知原因
没有持仓管理逻辑，平仓后可能立即重新下单，不符合用户的原始意图
cons_en: No autonomous strategy logic—entirely dependent on manual input, not an automated trading system
Stop loss and take profit use absolute price values instead of points/pips, requiring manual conversion for different instruments and error-prone
Checks and prints warnings on every tick; when SelectMode is None, it generates excessive useless log output
No error handling—trade function return values are not checked, so users are unaware when order placement fails
No position management logic; after a position closes, the EA may immediately re-enter, which may not match the user's original intent
improvements: 添加一次性下单标志位，确保EA只在首次满足条件时下单一次，避免平仓后自动重新入场
将止损止盈改为点数模式并提供自动计算功能，同时加入对输入参数的合法性验证（如SL/TP相对于入场价的方向检查）
检查trade.Buy/Sell等函数的返回值，失败时输出错误码和详细日志，并添加滑点和成交验证
增加魔术号码(MagicNumber)以区分不同EA的订单，避免与其他EA的持仓检查冲突
improvements_en: Add a one-shot execution flag to ensure the EA places an order only once on first condition match, preventing automatic re-entry after position closure
Change SL/TP to point-based mode with automatic price calculation, and add input validation such as verifying SL/TP direction relative to entry price
Check return values of trade.Buy/Sell functions, output error codes and detailed logs on failure, and add slippage and fill verification
Add a MagicNumber to distinguish this EA's orders from others, avoiding conflicts with position/order count checks from other EAs

risk_points: 没有错误处理机制，交易失败时静默无响应，可能导致用户误以为订单已成功下达
平仓后EA会在下一个tick重新下单，可能导致非预期的连续交易
使用绝对价格设置止损止盈，输入错误（如买卖方向颠倒）可能导致止损无法触发或立即触发
没有MagicNumber区分订单，与其他EA同账号运行时持仓检查会互相干扰
risk_points_en: No error handling—trade failures are silent, potentially leading users to believe orders were placed successfully
EA re-enters on the next tick after position closure, potentially causing unintended consecutive trades
Absolute price SL/TP—input errors (e.g., reversed direction) can cause SL to never trigger or trigger immediately
No MagicNumber for order discrimination—position checks conflict when running alongside other EAs on the same account
